quarterly_data.signal: H1 FY2026 (March - August 2025) semi-annual report: net sales JPY 65,602 million (up 8.9% year on year), which the company attributes mainly to higher demand from Taiwanese customers; operating profit JPY 16,214 million (down 5.4%); ordinary profit JPY 14,572 million (down 29.2%), also hit by foreign-exchange losses; net profit attributable to owners JPY 10,872 million (down 31.4%). Semiconductor & FPD equipment segment: sales JPY 65,236 million (up 8.9%), segment profit JPY 16,761 million (down 4.8%); life science: sales JPY 366 million (up 9.5%), segment loss JPY 119 million. H1 sales by customer location: Taiwan JPY 18,261 million, China JPY 18,793 million, United States JPY 15,472 million, Japan JPY 4,366 million, Korea JPY 3,590 million, other JPY 5,117 million. H1 R&D expenses JPY 737 million.
quarterly_data.figure: H1 FY2026 net sales JPY 65,602 million (+8.9%); operating profit JPY 16,214 million (-5.4%); net profit JPY 10,872 million (-31.4%)

quarterly_data.signal: Management states the market is led by the spread of devices with generative-AI functions and data-center investment, with investment in high-performance, low-power semiconductor technology accelerating; growth of the electric-vehicle market has slowed more than expected, but the semiconductor market as a whole is still expected to grow steadily.
